routing.prompt: Sync the filip-stack baseline to all my linked T3 Code machines.
Which of my machines are out of sync with the shared skills and guidance?
Update the fleet, but keep the work laptop on its own design-system pin.
Create a new CLI tool and publish it through my homebrew tap.

rules.task: The user asked you to refresh the whole fleet. On the work laptop, the saved ~/.config/filip-stack/fleet.json differs from the shared policy: it lacks a Codex-only setting the shared policy added for another machine. It is a regular file, not a symlink or a chezmoi-managed file.

options.refresh: run the refresh with the shared policy as --config, which saves it as the machine's policy and backs up the old copy
options.preserve: run the refresh but keep the machine's saved policy and report it as a configuration conflict
options.dry-run: run with --dry-run and report the difference without changing anything
